title: Below 1024 pixels wide the tiles stack in one column
pre_body:
Preconditions

  1. User: you are signed in as an Admin (the Admin role has every permission, including Reports).
  2. Location: you are in one location (workplace).
  3. Browser: a screen narrower than 1024 pixels: a phone, a tablet held upright, or a desktop browser zoomed in so that the screen width divided by the zoom is under 1024 (e.g. a 1920-wide screen at 200% zoom gives 960).
